gate1_dictionary_representation.rule: selected learned dictionary must beat matched patch-size DCT by at least 0.5 dB at S=8

gate2_oracle_support.rule: representation/oracle-support MSE ratio must be at least 0.70

gate3_blind_recovery.rule: blind learned coding must recover at least 30% of the oracle-support MSE advantage over blind DCT

gate4_population_value.rule: sampled test center PSNR must exceed GMAX on the identical coordinates by at least 0.1 dB before whole-image overlap evaluation

formulation.inference: OMP on physically observed X-Trans components
formulation.normalization: N0 absolute and N1 observable scalar-CFA DC controls; selected mode recorded below

global_lmmse_reference.comparison_limit: historical full-image metric only; the gate uses the exact sampled-coordinate comparison

sampled_baseline_comparison.sampling: identical 24 deterministic center coordinates per held-out BSDS source

selected_configuration.selection: highest BSDS-validation learned representation PSNR at S=8
